'''Wuglik''' was a [[Gamorrean/Legends|Gamorrean]], who lived on [[Dorumaa]]. He worked in [[Dorumaa Spaceport]], as a cargo handler for [[Intergalactic Freight]]. He was a patron of the [[Cantina Oceana]], which he visited several times a week. He was also good friends with the [[Ithorian/Legends|Ithorian]] [[Yatter]] and they would meet in the [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]] to watch sport on the [[Holovid/Legends|holovid]] together. On one occasion, they were in the cantina playing [[Bannak]] and watching the [[Galactic lightball playoffs]], when [[Echari Di'San]] got into a fight with [[Rysko Barnt]]. Barnt was murdered shortly afterwards and a group of spacers who were investigating the incident asked Wuglik some questions about it. Wuglik thought that it was obvious that Di'San had killed Rysko.
